messages.content: 問題：2025 年第二季所有物流商合計的平均配送天數？
{"thought": "先解析「配送天數」與「物流商」的語意定義，確認欄位與規則（特別是時區與日期範圍）。", "tool": "resolve_semantics", "args": {"mentions": ["配送天數", "物流商", "季度"], "context": "2025 年第二季所有物流商合計的平均配送天數？"}}

Inspect the data directly.", "candidates": [], "coverage_status": "unavailable"}], "requested_count": 3, "processed_count": 3, "skipped": [], "version": "v0-c2", "note": "Use these mappings only for the current analysis need.", "triggered_constraints": [{"id": "con_tz_order_time", "target": "map_order_time", "severity": "block", "description": "orders.order_ts 以 UTC 儲存，營運報表必須以台北時間（UTC+8）劃分日、月、季、年。換算後每月都有部分訂單改歸屬到下一個月（含跨年），不換算會造成月、季、年度歸屬錯誤。資料範圍含台北時間落在 2024 年與 2026 年的訂單，查詢 2025 年必須排除這兩端。資料本身無時區標記，時區規則來自文件。", "matched_by": "trigger_keywords"}]}
{"thought": "語意層對三個概念都沒有命中，需要直接檢視資料表結構來找出訂單、配送與物流商相關的欄位。", "tool": "get_schema", "args": {}}

TOOL_RESULT get_schema:
{"schema": "CREATE TABLE customers (customer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, email TEXT,
    region_code TEXT, signup_date TEXT, tier TEXT)
CREATE TABLE order_items (item_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, order_id INTEGER, product_id INTEGER,
    quantity INTEGER, unit_price_cents INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE orders (order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER, order_ts TEXT,
    status INTEGER, channel TEXT, coupon_code TEXT)
CREATE TABLE payments (payment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, order_id INTEGER, method TEXT,
    amount_twd INTEGER, paid_ts TEXT, payment_status TEXT)
CREATE TABLE products (product_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, sku TEXT, product_name TEXT,
    category TEXT, list_price_twd INTEGER, is_active INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE refunds (refund_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, order_id INTEGER, item_id INTEGER,
    refund_amount_twd INTEGER, refund_ts TEXT, reason_code TEXT)
CREATE TABLE shipments (shipment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, order_id INTEGER, carrier TEXT,
    shipped_ts TEXT, delivered_ts TEXT)"}

{"thought": "語意層沒有命中配送天數與物流商，先抽樣 shipments 的時間格式，確認 shipped_ts 與 delivered_ts 的字串格式與時區標記。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"query": "SELECT shipment_id, order_id, carrier, shipped_ts, delivered_ts FROM shipments LIMIT 10"}}

{"thought": "配送天數需要 shipments 的 shipped_ts 與 delivered_ts，但季度歸屬應依訂單時間（UTC 需換算台北時間）。先檢查 orders.order_ts 的格式，並確認 shipments 是否有缺值或無法解析的時間。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"queries": ["SELECT o.order_id, o.order_ts, s.shipped_ts, s.delivered_ts, s.carrier FROM orders o JOIN shipments s ON s.order_id = o.order_id LIMIT 10", "SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN shipped_ts IS NULL OR delivered_ts IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_ts, SUM(CASE WHEN delivered_ts < shipped_ts THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS reversed, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS distinct_orders FROM shipments"]}}

{"thought": "依 block 規則，把 orders.order_ts 從 UTC 換算成台北時間後，再篩選 2025-04-01 到 2025-06-30 的訂單。配送天數取 delivered_ts 減 shipped_ts，並排除兩個時間欄位為空的紀錄。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"query": "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(AVG(julianday(s.delivered_ts) - julianday(s.shipped_ts)), 2) AS avg_delivery_days FROM orders o JOIN shipments s ON s.order_id = o.order_id WHERE s.shipped_ts IS NOT NULL AND s.delivered_ts IS NOT NULL AND datetime(o.order_ts, '+8 hours') >= '2025-04-01 00:00:00' AND datetime(o.order_ts, '+8 hours') < '2025-07-01 00:00:00'"}}

{"thought": "平均值只納入可成功解析台北時間的訂單，我先確認 order_ts 沒有格式異常而被 datetime() 靜默排除。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"query": "SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_joined, SUM(CASE WHEN datetime(o.order_ts, '+8 hours') IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unparsed_ts FROM orders o JOIN shipments s ON s.order_id = o.order_id WHERE s.shipped_ts IS NOT NULL AND s.delivered_ts IS NOT NULL"}}

response: {"thought": "時區換算後的 Q2 篩選已完成，order_ts 也全數可解析、shipments 無倒置時間，平均值 2.91 有查詢結果支持，可以交付。", "tool": "submit_answer", "args": {"answer": "2.91", "basis": "依語意層的時區規則，將 orders.order_ts（UTC）加 8 小時換算為台北時間後，篩選 2025-04-01 至 2025-06-30 的訂單。配送天數定義為 shipments.delivered_ts 減 shipped_ts（以天為單位），排除任一時間為空的紀錄，共 9,921 筆；所有訂單時間皆可解析，且無 delivered 早於 shipped 的紀錄。"}}
